newsitem.title: USA: MGIC Investment authorizes share buyback.
newsitem.headline: MGIC Investment authorizes share buyback.

text.p: MGIC Investment Corp said Wednesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of of up $250 million in shares of the company's outstanding common stock.

MGIC said it expects to fund the repurchase program through a bank loan facility and operating cash flow. It received a commitment letter from a bank for up to $250 million to be used for the repurchase program and general corporate purposes.

MGIC said management is authorized to repurchase shares from time to time in open-market transactions or in privately negotiated transactions. The timing of repurchases and the number of shares repurchased will depend on market conditions and corporate requirements.
The repurchased shares will be available for general corporate purposes, the company said.
MGIC Investment Corp is the parent corporation of Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Corporation (MGIC).
